name: Invoice

fields.name: invoice_number
fields.description: Invoice No / Bill No / Reference number.

fields.name: exporter_name
fields.description: Full name of the seller/exporter/supplier issuing the invoice. Look for company name at the top left, letterhead, or footer signature block.

fields.name: exporter_address
fields.description: Complete address of the exporter (combine all address lines with comma separators).

fields.name: importer_name
fields.description: Full name of the buyer/consignee/importer. Look for 'Consignee', 'Bill To', 'Buyer', 'Importer', 'Ship To'.

fields.name: importer_address
fields.description: Complete address of the importer/consignee (combine all address lines).

fields.name: currency
fields.description: 3-letter ISO code (USD, EUR, GBP, INR, etc.).

fields.name: total_price
fields.description: Final grand total invoice amount due (numeric only).

examples:
GLOBAL EXPORTS INC.
123 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105, USA

BILL TO:
Acme Corp
456 Industrial Way, Seattle, WA 98101

Invoice: INV-9011
Date: 04/15/2023

Item	Qty	Price	Total
Widget A	10	$5.00	$50.00
Super Widget	2	$25.00	$50.00

Grand Total: USD 100.00
